meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能帮你排查容器化 agent 执行系统的问题:查主机与容器日志、用会话数据库(inbound.db / outbound.db)追消息流向、核对挂载、定位常见故障,并给出重启或清理命令。
howto.when: 当事情不工作时、容器启动失败、出现认证问题,或你想弄清容器系统如何运作时,它会接管排查。

say.text: 机器人不回复了,帮我看看哪里出的问题
say.note: 会先查主机错误日志与会话数据库消息流

say.text: 容器一启动就退出,日志里该看什么?
say.note: 会按 LOG_LEVEL=debug 定位容器 stderr

say.text: 帮我把某个会话的容器重启一下
say.note: 会用 ncl groups restart 重启该组的容器

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps debug the containerized agent execution system: it reads host and container logs, traces message flow through the session DBs (inbound.db / outbound.db), checks mounts, and diagnoses common failures.
howto.when_en: Use it when things aren't working, a container fails to start, authentication problems appear, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying, help me find what's wrong
say_en.note: It checks host error logs and session DB flow first

say_en.text: The container exits right after spawn, what should I look at?
say_en.note: It locates container stderr via LOG_LEVEL=debug

say_en.text: Restart the container for one of my sessions
say_en.note: It uses ncl groups restart for that group
